::: {.callout-warning}
**The app has not been updated to the redesigned database schema** ([Database](database.qmd)).
Its queries target the previous layout, so it won't work against the current pipeline DB yet.
:::

## Launching

```r
Sys.setenv(STABILITY_DB = "results/targets/stability.sqlite")   # optional
shiny::runApp("app")
```

```sh
STABILITY_DB=/path/to/stability.sqlite Rscript -e "shiny::runApp('app')"
```

- `STABILITY_DB` picks the database; if unset, the app uses `db_path` from
  `config/pipeline.yml` (launched from the project root or `app/`).
- The app only reads the DB. Datasets, methods and fits are queried live, so new results appear
  on the next launch.

## What it shows

A drill-down explorer: dataset > method > rank or parameter > factor. A breadcrumb at the top
navigates back up, and a global toggle switches the similarity metric (cosine, Pearson,
Spearman) everywhere.

| Level | Scope | Shows |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | dataset | each method's headline stability, fit and failure counts |
| 1 | method | stability by rank across seeds; reconstruction error by rank (PCA, sPCA); cross-rank persistence and factor-tracking trajectories; for WGCNA, agreement between powers, module counts and the scale-free-topology fit |
| 2 | rank or parameter | seed × seed matched similarity; per-factor stability; factor × factor heatmaps with matches outlined (WGCNA: module sizes and cross-power overlap) |
| 3 | factor | top-loading genes; the factor's match in every other fit; enrichment results from the pipeline |

PCA and sPCA are deterministic, so their Level 1 is a reconstruction-error-by-rank plot. PCA is
one fit at the largest rank; viewing rank *n* shows its first *n* components.

A separate **Compare methods** screen (top-right toggle) takes any two fits -- e.g. a PCA fit as a
baseline against an NMF, CoGAPS or WGCNA fit -- and shows their factor or eigengene similarity
(matched by absolute value, so a strong match to a component's negative side shows correctly)
alongside each side's enrichment results.

## Not yet in the app

- Views across datasets (the DB already holds projections and gene-space agreement).
- Fetching data directly from the HuggingFace Hub (local paths only).
